goalZh: 读懂一封学期总结和假期安排的通知邮件,找出时间、地点和要做的事
canDoZh: 能读懂一封学期总结和假期安排的邮件,找出放假安排和要做的事

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: (学期最后一周,劳拉发给咖啡馆全体员工的邮件)大家好!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There were a lot of new customers, and you were all great.
lines.zh: 新顾客特别多,你们每个人都做得很棒。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lei, our new guy, was nervous on his first day.
lines.zh: 我们的新同事磊,第一天上班的时候很紧张。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now he's confident, and the customers love him!
lines.zh: 现在他很自信,顾客们都很喜欢他!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After this Friday, there's no work for four weeks.
lines.zh: 这周五以后放四周假,不用来上班。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We're back one week before the new semester.
lines.zh: 新学期开学前一周,我们回来开门。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We're going to have a party this Friday at five, here at the cafe.
lines.zh: 这周五下午五点,我们要在店里办个小聚会。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's food, coffee, and tea. Friends are welcome, too!
lines.zh: 有吃的、咖啡和茶。也欢迎带朋友来!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Get some rest, and have fun!
lines.zh: 假期里好好休息,玩得开心!

questions.prompt: 劳拉在邮件里说磊这学期怎么样?
options: 第一天很紧张,现在很自信,顾客都喜欢他
questions.explainZh: Lei, our new guy, was nervous on his first day. Now he's confident, and the customers love him!(磊第一天很紧张,现在很自信,顾客都喜欢他。)

questions.prompt: 放假期间,咖啡馆怎么安排?
options: 这周五以后放四周假,新学期开学前一周回来
questions.explainZh: After this Friday, there's no work for four weeks. We're back one week before the new semester.(这周五以后放四周假,新学期开学前一周回来。)

questions.prompt: 聚会是什么时候、在哪儿?
options: 周五晚上七点,在劳拉家
周六下午五点,在咖啡馆
周五下午五点,在咖啡馆
questions.explainZh: We're going to have a party this Friday at five, here at the cafe.(这周五五点,在店里办聚会。)

questions.prompt: 关于聚会,邮件里还说了什么?
options: 有吃的、咖啡和茶,也欢迎带朋友来
questions.explainZh: There's food, coffee, and tea. Friends are welcome, too!(有吃的、咖啡和茶,也欢迎带朋友来!)

grammar.titleZh: 回顾用过去时,说安排用 be going to
grammar.bodyZh: 这封邮件前半段回顾这学期,用一般过去时:This semester was really busy.、There were a lot of new customers.、Lei was nervous on his first day.;后半段说接下来的安排,用 be going to 或一般现在时:We're going to have a party this Friday.、We're back one week before the new semester.。同一封邮件里,时间一变,动词也跟着变,别把 was 写成 is。读通知类的邮件,先找时间(this Friday at five)、地点(here at the cafe)和要做的事,最后看是谁发的。

examples.text: There were a lot of new customers.
We're going to have a party this Friday.
examples.zh: 这周五我们要办个聚会。
